title: Mizjah Ruins
wikitext:
[[Image:Mizjah Ruins.jpg|thumb|300px|Mizjah Ruins]]

The '''Mizjah Ruins''' are an area southeast of [[Grom'gol Base Camp]] inhabited by [[Mosh'Ogg Brute]]s and [[Mosh'Ogg Witch Doctor]]s. These [[ogre]]s are responsible for ambushing supply [[caravan]]s going to [[Stonard]].
